Arrange an eye examination by an aviation medical examiner for any crew member exposed before their next duty.
Inform the airport operator and local police so the source can be traced.
The pilot not exposed should take or keep control; avoid looking at the beam.
Record the approximate position of the source relative to the runway.
Turn up cockpit lighting to reduce the effect of glare.
Track repeat locations and share them with the airport and police for awareness drives.
